notes: Identity assessment: supplied cache is a long empirical Many Labs 2 report body, with methods, original-study summaries, replication results, discussion and references. It names Many Labs 2 and the 28-effect/slate design, and its Huang, Miyamoto/Kitayama, Gray/Wegner and Bauer sections identify the referenced original works and Study 1a/1/1a/4 respectively. Content is consistent with the assigned Klein et al. (2018) primary report rather than a secondary article or preregistration. However, title, report author list and report DOI are absent from this parse, so exact bibliographic identity is not independently fully established; positive fields require parent identity review. No PDF was supplied. Table 2 and Table 3 headings survive but their numerical bodies do not. Only assigned unfinished fields are evaluated; other schema fields are null placeholders. No N was inferred from degrees of freedom, and no metric conversions were performed. Candidate aggregate adjusted correspondence-bias test: N = 7,197; F(2, 7194) = 3,042.00; p < 2.2e -16; d = 1.82. Not transferred to WEIRD subgroup. General narrative that most reliable effects are similar across cultures does not uniquely establish this subgroup verdict.
